description: Ministry of Health & Indigenous Medical Services -  7th Amendment to the Service Minute of Sri Lanka Nursing Services
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns amendments to the Sri Lanka Nursing Services Minute, which involves public service regulations, promotions, and service conditions for nursing officers. It falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with public sector service administration, qualifications, and promotion procedures rather than government structure/personnel changes or other specialized categories.
